summary: NextEra Energy filed an 8-K (Items 8.01/9.01) on November 5, 2026, updating its previously disclosed May 15, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger to acquire Dominion Energy, Inc. for stock consideration via a two-step structure: Merger Sub Corp merges into Dominion (First Merger), then the surviving corporation merges into LLC Sub. The filing files financial information for incorporation by reference into NEE's Securities Act registration statements. No revised price or premium is stated; closing remains subject to Virginia SCC certificate issuance and customary conditions. Watch regulatory approval timing and shareholder votes.
